data.content_ref: inline:All four foundations are the same mechanism: the skeptical fixpoint leaves a residual structure of defeated attacks, and each foundation is a different polynomial lens onto that residue. SRC_002 makes the residual defense set explicit; SRC_004 probes it by deletion; SRC_003 names the local reason; SRC_008 records the standing cause. The covering principle abstracts this: the grounded extension's output is not just a labeling but a residual attack structure, and all admissible diagnostics are polynomial functions of that structure. REFUTED IF two graphs with isomorphic residual attack structures can produce different grounded labelings, or if any diagnostic is not a function of the residual structure alone.
